tool_args.rationale: The W1 bridge signature points to the two-layer siphon law, but the existing rows vary only u_now and keep s_grad fixed at 1. The open-branch probe can vary the sink gradient and discriminate the branch contribution before fitting a confirmed model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit node_C/W1 epidemic-mobility bridge siphon immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows have the same s_grad, so inhibition strength and source scale are confounded, and the open branch contribution remains unresolved.
The bridge signature maps to a static siphon response; no coupled memory ODE evidence warrants a trajectory batch.
It is explicitly irrelevant to resolving this structural ambiguity and has higher cost.
